request.description: Custom fields are extra data fields you create to store additional information about your contacts, such as preferences, membership levels, and interests. Use custom fields to organize contacts, send personalized email campaigns, and to identify a targeted audience for a specific campaign. Custom fields types include text, number, date, drop-down lists, radio buttons, and checkboxes. A user can configure up to 100 `custom_fields` in their account.
